title: Xavier Isaac 2024 Panini Prizm Blue Ice #275 Tampa Bay
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This Xavier Isaac Blue Ice Prizm trading card is a must-have for any baseball fan. With a card number of 275, it features the Tampa Bay outfielder in a stunning blue ice parallel variety. This card is part of the 2024 Panini Prizm set and is perfect for collectors who are looking to add a unique and rare card to their collection. 

The card is not autographed, but it still holds a lot of value. It is approved by Major League Baseball (MLB) and Minor League Baseball (MiLB) and is a great addition to any sports trading card collection. This card is perfect for those who want to complete their collection or those who want to add a unique card to their collection.
